A Pleasant Vietnamese Dining Experience
Jun 2026 • Solo
First, I had the Cơm Tấm. The rice was soft and freshly cooked. The pork spare ribs were sweet and tender, although I don't think a single rib was enough. The chả trứng was also quite good. However, the sausage didn't taste handmade; it felt more like a store-bought product. It was also a bit tough. Next, I tried the Cuốn Diếp Tôm Tươi (lettuce fresh rolls with prawn). The ingredients were fresh, and I enjoyed the dipping sauce that came with it. The rolls were visually appealing, but they fell apart easily when eaten. Lastly, I had the Tàu Hủ Nước Đường Gừng (bean curd in ginger syrup). The tofu was silky smooth texture. The syrup wasn't very sweet, and I could still taste a hint of ginger.

Angus Gibson
Aberfeldy, United Kingdom44 contributions
0
Well worth the higher price!
Jun 2025 • Couples
We chose this place deliberately to be our last dinner in Vietnam and we certainly ended our trip on a high! The pork skewers came out first and were delicious despite their simplicity. The pork and eggs were our favourite. The meat slid right off the bone and the sauce…wow! I need that recipe. The duck stir fry was recommended to us by the manager and we were so glad he convinced us to try it. My girl friend had the lychee juice and it was one of the freshest drinks we had ever tasted. The price was obviously higher than your average restaurant but I do believe that it was worth it. The bill took a long time to come after we requested it, however the staff member did inform us of an issue with the card machine. We also loved the gift shop and picked up a few things on our way out.

At Mặn Mòi, we strive to offer not only authentic and carefully prepared dishes but also a meaningful cultural experience in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Your feedback encourages us to keep improving every detail and delivering memorable moments for our guests.
